data.title: Wheeler Peak Scenic Drive Seasonal Closure
data.description: Wheeler Peak Scenic Drive is closed to vehicle traffic at the Upper Lehman Creek Campground for the winter season.

data.title: Dump Station Seasonal Closure
data.description: Due to incoming winter weather, the park's dump station will be closing for the season at 12:00 pm on Friday, October 9, 2026. After that time, there will be no potable water available inside the National Park.

data.title: Wheeler Peak Campground Seasonal Closure
data.description: The Wheeler Peak Campground will close for the season on Saturday, October 10, 2026. Availability in the other park campgrounds can be found on recreation.gov.

data.title: No Potable Water in Park Campgrounds
data.description: There currently is no water available in any campground in Great Basin National Park.  Water is available at the RV Fill and Dump Station, the Great Basin, and the Lehman Caves Visitor Center as well as some local businesses.
